sensors.guide: Ruff must pass on every file you touch; fix the code rather than the rule.
The project must type-check with mypy before the turn ends.
Run pytest before claiming done; fix the code, never the tests.

sensors.cmd: if [ -f .rig/gen/importlinter.ini ]; then PYTHONPATH=src lint-imports --config .rig/gen/importlinter.ini; else echo 'layers: not enforced here (no approved layers config)'; fi
sensors.guide: Respect the approved layers in architecture.md; do not import across a forbidden boundary.
Reuse existing code instead of copying it; the duplicated share may not grow past its baseline.

sensors.cmd: if semgrep --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then semgrep scan --config p/default --error --metrics=off --disable-version-check --quiet {changed}; s=$?; [ $s -le 1 ] || [ -n "$CI" ] && exit $s; echo "sast: Semgrep could not scan here (exit $s: offline, or the rules did not load), so CI scans this change"; elif [ -n "$CI" ]; then echo 'sast: Semgrep does not run in CI (pipx install semgrep)'; exit 1; else echo 'sast: Semgrep does not run here (missing or broken), so CI scans this change (pipx install semgrep to scan locally)'; fi
sensors.guide: Semgrep scans the source files this change touches for security bugs (injection, unsafe input, secrets, weak crypto); fix the code rather than silencing the rule.

sensors.cmd: if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip-audit -r requirements.txt; elif [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip-audit .; else echo 'audit: no requirements.txt or pyproject.toml, nothing to audit'; fi
sensors.guide: Do not add dependencies with known vulnerabilities.

sensors.cmd: S="${RIG_SDLC:-.rig/bin/sdlc.ts}"; [ -f "$S" ] || { echo 'mutation-diff: sdlc not found; re-run sdlc.ts vendor'; exit 1; }; mutmut --version 2>&1 | grep -Eq '[^0-9]2\.[0-9]' || { echo 'mutation-diff: mutmut 2.x is not installed (3.x has no junitxml): pip install "mutmut<3", or the person waives mutation-diff'; exit 1; }; rm -rf .mutmut-cache .rig-mutmut.xml; { mutmut run --paths-to-mutate "$(echo {changed:py} | tr ' ' ',')" || true; mutmut junitxml --untested-policy=failure --suspicious-policy=failure > .rig-mutmut.xml; } >&2; node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning "$S" mutscore --tool mutmut --report .rig-mutmut.xml --lines {changed-lines:py}; s=$?; rm -rf .mutmut-cache .rig-mutmut.xml; exit $s
sensors.guide: Every line this change adds is pinned by a test: the mutation score on the changed lines must reach mutation.minScore; a survivor names a line and a change no test noticed, and goes back to the test writer.
Tests must assert behaviour so that changing the code makes them fail.
